paper_title: Towards an electrostatic storage ring for fundamental physics measurements
notes: Projection paper for a proposed electrostatic storage ring. Main DM sensitivity is to axion-electron coupling (demonstrator, Fig 4 left) and axion-nucleon coupling (final stage with Xe sample, Fig 4 right), plus dark photon. Mass range 1e-19 to 1e-10 eV. The pre-analysis hint of AxionEDM is not the primary DM exclusion result; EDM is a separate measurement goal. No numerical data points are tabulated; only plotted projection curves with axis ranges (mass 1e-19 to 1e-9 eV, g_ae from ~1e-11 to higher). Multiple coupling types discussed, so confidence reduced. | Vision: Left panel y-axis is g_aee in GeV^-1 (axion-electron coupling). Lower boundary of existing exclusion region traced from torsion pendulum, comagnetometer, and long-range interaction grey curves. The blue (1s) and red (5h) lines are projected sensitivities, not exclusions. The 'Long-range' horizontal line sits at ~5e-5 GeV^-1 at higher masses. Note: g_aee here is in GeV^-1, not dimensionless as typical g_ae; reported as-is from plot axis. | Calibration: No calibration needed
